original_value: Compact pocket audio interface for mobile creators and podcasters, featuring dual 24-bit inputs, direct monitoring, and USB-C connectivity. Includes a built-in loopback mode for streaming and a rugged matte shell for field recording setups.

result.paraphrase: Portable pocket-sized audio interface for creators and podcasters on the go, with dual 24-bit inputs, direct monitoring, and USB-C connection. It also has a built-in loopback mode for streaming and a rugged matte exterior for field recording setups.
